q.line: Don’t it seem like a good time for swimming
stanza: This whole world is dying
Don’t it seem like a good time for swimming
Before all the water disappears?
Parker Lake Beach
All of the sunnys swimming
I wanna see
To feel my body sinking, sinking

partner.line: To feel my body sinking, sinking

q.line: When I take the prisoners swimming
stanza: When I take the prisoners swimming
They have the time of their lives
I love to watch them floating
On their backs
Unburden and relaxed

partner.line: They have the time of their lives

q.line: Out on Sullivan's Island, they're swimming
stanza: Out on Sullivan's Island, they're swimming
On the beach where the big boats rolled in
With the earliest slaves and their children
Our first American kin

partner.line: On the beach where the big boats rolled in

q.line: We went down the lake to go swimming
stanza: We went down the lake to go swimming
Down to the lake for a swim
Susie said, "water cures cancer"
I asked her to please call me Jim

partner.line: Down to the lake for a swim

q.line: 'Cause I'm a wild god flying and a wild god swimming
stanza: A wild god searching for a faraway girl
Who was basically a mirage but nevertheless loomed large
She would hang under the rail as he blew 'round the room
And make love with a kind of efficient gloom
And the people on the ground cried, "When does it start?"
And the wild god says, "It starts with the heart, with the heart, with the hear…
And the people on the ground cried, "When does it end?"
And the wild god says, "Well, it depends, but it mostly never ends
'Cause I'm a wild god flying and a wild god swimming
And I'm an old, sick god dying and crying and singing"

partner.line: And I'm an old, sick god dying and crying and singing"
